decisions.reason: A safety shoe line launched only in 2023 is core to the firm's business, so carrying it costs little while its market value is still unresolved.
A comfort insole is cheap to keep in a large accessory range, and one year of mere mentions leaves its prospects open, so the option is still worth holding.
This supportive insole has low carrying cost and still-uncertain demand, though it overlaps with several other insole options the firm holds.
The ergonomic series has its own dedicated page, which signals active commitment, and its value is still unfolding, so keeping the option is justified.
Firefighter boots open a specialized segment where certification investment is already sunk and adoption takes time, so the uncertainty has not yet resolved.
As a home-page flagship tied to the firm's innovation direction, the moulded insole has no evidence of failure and deserves further commitment.
